text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 74 units of the 50 mg/50 mL presentation (8.2 days) and 129 units of the 250 mg/2.5 mL presentation (11.3 days). Corvale General holds 159.6 units (16.5 days). All current stock is labeled by Eugia US LLC and manufactured at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) in India.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected the Eugia plant on 2024-02-02 and classified the inspection OAI, with the classification known on 2024-05-02. FDA issued a Warning Letter to the plant on 2024-08-15. FDA inspected the plant again on 2026-02-06 and classified that inspection OAI, with the classification known on 2026-09-21. Argatroban is not on FDA's drug shortage list.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below two weeks for both presentations. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a limited transfer. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, but their labels do not identify manufacturing sites we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 24 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate Accord Healthcare Inc. product for purchase — approved by buyer.
3. Evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC product for purchase — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate Caplin Steriles Limited product for purchase — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC product for purchase — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
